Casual · trust-based. The host's browser runs the match and each browser reports its own reveal-to-answer time, so a modified browser could cheat. Fine between friends. No coins and no Babu rank: a friend duel pays XP on each device, and each device keeps its own record.

Both browsers find each other through public relays and public STUN servers (Google’s and Cloudflare’s), then talk directly and learn each other’s internet (IP) address, as in any video call. Some office and mobile networks block direct connections, and there is no relay server of ours to fall back on. The room code is the only key to the room. The public relays see a scrambled, stretched form of it that takes a lot of computing power to reverse, but someone who spends that could still work out a code later, and with it both players' internet (IP) addresses.
